hero.h1: Epoxy Countertops Canonsburg Kitchens Can Keep for Less
hero.subheadline: Walker's Epoxy resurfaces the counters you already have with a custom, one of a kind marble look, so you skip the cost and mess of ripping them out.

image.alt: Epoxy countertops Canonsburg project: white epoxy island top with bold black veining over dark cabinets

paragraphs: Walker's Epoxy Countertops & Tables installs epoxy countertops Canonsburg homeowners choose when their counters are dated but still solid. Instead of tearing out laminate or dark granite, Cody pours a custom epoxy finish right over them, with white marble veining, soft cream swirls or bold black and red.

One customer was ready to move on from her dark granite but could not bring herself to rip it out, because there was nothing wrong with it. Cody resurfaced it instead. Another client said he brought her kitchen counters back to life for a fraction of the cost of new countertops. Every design is custom, so no two look alike.

services.h2: Epoxy countertops Canonsburg homes, plus vanities, bars and floors

items.name: Epoxy kitchen countertops
items.blurb: Custom epoxy poured over your existing kitchen counters for a high-end stone look without the price of granite or marble. Choose crisp white with black veins, white with gold, warm cream, or a darker marble look. Each pour is one of a kind.

image.alt: Close-up of glossy white epoxy countertop with dramatic black and gray veining

items.name: Countertop resurfacing
items.blurb: Dated laminate or dark granite that is still in good shape can be resurfaced instead of replaced. One customer kept her dark granite and had it resurfaced for a fresh, light look. Another called the result counters brought back to life for a fraction of the cost.

image.alt: Kitchen with honey oak cabinets and resurfaced cream and white epoxy countertops with a raised bar ledge

items.name: Bathroom vanity tops
items.blurb: Original vanity tops, even custom ones, can get a new finish. One homeowner's spare bathroom had a custom double-sink top that was looking rough. Cody sent ideas and photos before the job, then resurfaced it in a soft cream marble look.

image.alt: Double-sink bathroom vanity with resurfaced cream marble-look epoxy top and dark wood cabinet

items.name: Backsplashes
items.blurb: Carry the same epoxy finish up the wall for a seamless counter and backsplash. One kitchen got matching white and gray marble-look epoxy on both the countertop and the full backsplash behind the sink, under the original wood cabinets.

image.alt: Kitchen countertop and full backsplash finished in white and gray marble-look epoxy under wood cabinets

items.name: Bar tops and tables
items.blurb: Bar tops and tables are in the company name. Recent work includes a customer's kitchen plus their downstairs bar top in Penn State colors, and bold one-off designs like a black, white and red marble top. Bring your idea and Cody will design around it.

image.alt: Countertop in black, white and red marble-look epoxy against a red wall

items.name: Floors, steps and patios
items.blurb: Epoxy is not just for counters. Walker's also coats concrete floors, sub floors, patios and steps, and spring is a busy floor season. Call to ask about a basement, garage or patio floor and how scheduling works for your job.

items.title: Keep what still works
items.text: If your counters are solid but dated, there is no need to rip them out. Resurfacing gives you a new look for a fraction of the cost of new countertops.

items.title: Truly one of a kind
items.text: Every top is a custom, one of a kind design. White with black veins, white with gold, cream swirls, team colors or black and red: no two finishes come out the same.

items.title: Ideas before the job starts
items.text: One client said Cody immediately began sending ideas and photos and answered all his questions, then showed up on time and worked quietly and hard.

items.title: Hundreds of finished jobs to see
items.text: The Google profile holds 773 photos and 54 reviews, with countertops mentioned in 37 of them, and 2,470 people follow the work on Facebook.

about.text: Walker's Epoxy Countertops & Tables is Cody's epoxy business in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania. He resurfaces kitchen counters, bathroom vanity tops, backsplashes, bar tops and tables, and coats floors, patios and steps. Clients describe him as on time, professional, quiet and hard working, with an amazing personality. His goal is simple: give you the fancy, high-end look without spending all that money on granite or marble. The business replies to its Google reviews to thank customers, and it shares finished kitchens, vanities and bar tops on its Facebook page.

image.alt: Installer working on a double-sink bathroom vanity top being finished in white and gray epoxy

steps.title: Call, email or message
steps.text: Reach Walker's at (724) 206-3688, Countertopkid07@gmail.com or on Facebook with photos of the counters you want to change.

steps.title: Ideas and photos
steps.text: Cody sends you design ideas and photos of past finishes and answers your questions, so you can pick a look you love.

steps.title: Schedule the pour
steps.text: Set a date. Clients say Cody shows up on time and works quietly while the area is masked and prepared.

steps.title: Enjoy the new look
steps.text: Your existing counters, vanity or bar top get a custom epoxy finish, without tearing anything out or buying new stone.

service_area.text: Walker's Epoxy Countertops & Tables is based in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, the town listed on its Facebook page. Google does not show a street address or a set service area, since the work happens at your home. Call (724) 206-3688 or send a Facebook message with your town and a few photos of your counters, and Cody will let you know if he can fit you in.

items.q: Can you put epoxy over my existing countertops?
items.a: Yes, that is the main service. Walker's resurfaces existing kitchen counters, including dark granite that is still in good shape, plus bathroom vanity tops. One customer kept her granite and had it resurfaced instead of buying new. Send photos so Cody can look at your current counters.

items.q: How much does it cost compared to new countertops?
items.a: Walker's does not publish prices, since every job is custom. Clients say the result came in at a fraction of the cost of new countertops, and the company's pitch is the high-end look without spending all that money on granite or marble. Call for a quote on your counters.

items.q: What colors and looks can I choose?
items.a: Every design is custom and one of a kind. Past jobs include white with black veins, white with gold veins, cream marble swirls, gray swirls, black, white and red, and a bar top in Penn State colors. Cody sends ideas and photos to help you choose before the work.

items.q: Do you do floors and other surfaces?
items.a: Yes. Besides countertops and backsplashes, Walker's coats concrete floors, sub floors, patios and steps, and builds epoxy tables and bar tops. Floor season picks up in spring when the weather turns nicer, so call early to get on the schedule for a basement, garage or patio.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
items.a: Call (724) 206-3688, email Countertopkid07@gmail.com, or message Walker's Epoxy on Facebook. Include a few photos of the counters, vanity or floor you want to change and your town. Cody answers questions and sends design ideas before you schedule anything.

final_cta.text: Send Cody a photo and get ideas for your kitchen, vanity or bar top.
